title: [review] lora_ipv6_mesh-mkk4: rust/target/ build artifacts tracked in git
description:
## Severity: P0 correctness

64,679 files under `rust/target/` are tracked by git. These include binary build outputs (`.o`, `.bin`), generated docs (`rust/target/doc/`), incremental compilation artifacts, and lock files.

## Root cause
`.gitignore` does not contain `rust/target/`. The standard Rust `.gitignore` entry `/target/` is missing.

## Impact
- Bloats repo size with generated, non-source files
- Every `cargo build` produces dirty tracked files
- Binary artifacts and docs fluctuate with compiler versions

## Fix
1. Add `rust/target/` to `.gitignore`
2. `git rm -r --cached rust/target/` to untrack existing files
3. Commit the `.gitignore` + removal
